summary.text: Brendan Trachsel is the Green Party candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A higher education professional and Northern Arizona University graduate, he advanced from the Green Party primary on July 21, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Trachsel earned a bachelor's degree from Northern Arizona University in 2023 and a graduate degree from the university in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a 25-year-old student affairs professional who has registered students to vote in Flagstaff.
He said he spoke to the Flagstaff city council against a Flock camera surveillance contract and that the city canceled the contract in December 2025.

Trachsel said he is running to be the first third-party candidate elected to state or legislative office in Arizona, and he described five priorities: labor, education, environment, democracy and privacy.
